stem: In the figure, line \(AB\) is parallel to line \(CD\). What is the value of \(x\)?
solution: Angle \(BEF\) and angle \(CFE\) lie between the parallel lines on opposite sides of the transversal, so they are alternate interior angles.
Alternate interior angles are equal, so \(x = 57\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is \(2 \cdot 57\); alternate interior angles are equal, so nothing is doubled.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is \(180 - 57\), which treats the angles as same-side interior angles. They are on opposite sides of the transversal, so they are equal.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \(90 - 57\); the angles are not complementary. Alternate interior angles are equal.
explanation.D: Correct. Alternate interior angles formed by parallel lines are equal, so \(x = 57\).

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'C': 'A', 'D': 'B', 'A': 'C', 'B': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'C', 'B': 'D', 'C': 'A', 'D': 'B'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert P['A'][1]==P['B'][1] and P['C'][1]==P['D'][1]
assert abs(ang('B','E','F')-57)<0.1
ans=57
assert abs(ang('C','F','E')-ans)<0.1
assert value(choices[answer])==ans
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
